def run(ctx):
    query = ctx.query
    TOP_K = 10
    CANDIDATE_K = 120

    valid_doc_types = [
        "account_brief", "alias_registry", "approval_ledger", "authority_matrix",
        "escalation", "guide", "meeting_note", "policy", "product_footprint",
        "release", "roadmap", "runbook", "sales_discovery", "security_advisory",
        "security_ticket", "war_room_roster"
    ]
    valid_sources = [
        "crm", "eval_policy", "governance", "jira", "release_notes", "roadmap",
        "runbook", "security", "source_of_truth", "support", "vendor_advisory"
    ]

    analysis = ctx.query_understanding.analyze(query)
    entities = analysis.get("entities", [])
    entity_texts = []
    for entity in entities:
        text = entity.get("text", "")
        if text:
            entity_texts.append(text)
    linked_entities = ctx.entity_linking.link(" ".join(entity_texts))

    rewrite_result = ctx.query_rewrite.rewrite(
        query,
        analysis=analysis,
        linked_entities=linked_entities
    )
    rewrites = rewrite_result.get("rewrites", [])

    q_lower = query.lower()
    exactish_terms = []
    for token in ["cache", "namespace", "proof", "regulated", "customer", "release", "evidence", "feature"]:
        if token in q_lower:
            exactish_terms.append(token)

    noun_chunks = analysis.get("noun_chunks", [])
    intents = analysis.get("intents", [])
    subqueries = analysis.get("subqueries", [])
    long_or_multihop = len(query.split()) > 14 or len(subqueries) > 1 or "which" in q_lower
    needs_authority = "proof" in q_lower or "evidence" in q_lower or "source of truth" in q_lower
    asks_customer = "customer" in q_lower or "account" in q_lower
    asks_release = "release" in q_lower

    routes = []
    routes.append({
        "name": "exact_policy_release_bm25",
        "mode": "bm25",
        "query": query,
        "top_k": 35,
        "include_doc_types": ["release", "authority_matrix", "policy", "product_footprint", "account_brief", "alias_registry"],
        "include_sources": ["release_notes", "source_of_truth", "governance", "crm", "eval_policy"],
        "must_terms": [],
        "should_terms": exactish_terms,
        "bm25_weight": 0.70
    })

    if needs_authority:
        routes.append({
            "name": "authority_source_of_truth_hybrid",
            "mode": "hybrid",
            "query": "cache namespace proof source of truth authority release feature regulated customer",
            "top_k": 30,
            "include_doc_types": ["authority_matrix", "release", "policy", "approval_ledger", "security_ticket"],
            "include_sources": ["source_of_truth", "release_notes", "governance", "security", "jira"],
            "must_terms": [],
            "should_terms": ["cache", "namespace", "proof", "release", "feature"],
            "bm25_weight": 0.60
        })

    if asks_customer:
        routes.append({
            "name": "customer_alias_crm_bm25",
            "mode": "bm25",
            "query": "regulated customer cache namespace proof alias account brief sales discovery",
            "top_k": 25,
            "include_doc_types": ["account_brief", "sales_discovery", "alias_registry", "security_ticket", "escalation"],
            "include_sources": ["crm", "support", "security", "jira", "source_of_truth"],
            "must_terms": [],
            "should_terms": ["regulated", "customer", "cache", "namespace", "proof"],
            "bm25_weight": 0.75
        })

    if asks_release:
        routes.append({
            "name": "release_evidence_bm25",
            "mode": "bm25",
            "query": "release cache namespace evidence feature customer proof",
            "top_k": 25,
            "include_doc_types": ["release", "product_footprint", "guide", "runbook", "security_advisory"],
            "include_sources": ["release_notes", "source_of_truth", "runbook", "security", "vendor_advisory"],
            "must_terms": [],
            "should_terms": ["cache", "namespace", "release", "feature", "evidence"],
            "bm25_weight": 0.72
        })

    if long_or_multihop:
        semantic_query = "multi hop identify regulated customer asking for cache namespace proof then connect to authoritative release evidence and cited feature"
        routes.append({
            "name": "multihop_dense",
            "mode": "dense",
            "query": semantic_query,
            "top_k": 25,
            "include_doc_types": ["account_brief", "sales_discovery", "security_ticket", "release", "authority_matrix", "product_footprint"],
            "include_sources": valid_sources,
            "must_terms": [],
            "should_terms": [],
            "bm25_weight": 0.50
        })

    for rewrite in rewrites:
        if rewrite and len(routes) < 8:
            routes.append({
                "name": "rewrite_hybrid",
                "mode": "hybrid",
                "query": rewrite,
                "top_k": 20,
                "include_doc_types": ["account_brief", "alias_registry", "authority_matrix", "release", "policy", "product_footprint", "security_ticket", "sales_discovery"],
                "include_sources": ["crm", "source_of_truth", "release_notes", "governance", "security", "jira", "support"],
                "must_terms": [],
                "should_terms": exactish_terms,
                "bm25_weight": 0.58
            })

    ctx.log("agentic_plan", {
        "query": query,
        "routes": routes,
        "rewrite_method": rewrite_result.get("method", ""),
        "rewrite_count": len(rewrites),
        "entity_texts": entity_texts,
        "intents": intents,
        "noun_chunks": noun_chunks
    })

    by_doc_id = {}
    route_notes = {}
    protected_ids = {}

    for route in routes:
        hits = ctx.search.search(
            route["query"],
            mode=route["mode"],
            top_k=route["top_k"],
            bm25_weight=route["bm25_weight"],
            include_doc_types=route["include_doc_types"],
            include_sources=route["include_sources"],
            must_terms=route["must_terms"],
            should_terms=route["should_terms"],
            exclude_doc_types=[],
            exclude_sources=[],
            exclude_terms=[]
        )
        rank = 0
        for hit in hits:
            rank = rank + 1
            data = hit.as_dict()
            doc_id = data.get("doc_id", "")
            if not doc_id:
                continue
            score = data.get("score", 0)
            doc_type = data.get("doc_type", "")
            source = data.get("source", "")
            text_blob = (data.get("title", "") + " " + data.get("text", "") + " " + data.get("snippet", "")).lower()

            authority_bonus = 0
            if source in ["source_of_truth", "release_notes", "governance"]:
                authority_bonus = authority_bonus + 0.08
            if doc_type in ["release", "authority_matrix", "account_brief", "alias_registry"]:
                authority_bonus = authority_bonus + 0.06
            if "cache" in text_blob and "namespace" in text_blob:
                authority_bonus = authority_bonus + 0.10
            if "proof" in text_blob or "evidence" in text_blob:
                authority_bonus = authority_bonus + 0.05
            if "regulated" in text_blob:
                authority_bonus = authority_bonus + 0.04

            adjusted = score + authority_bonus + (0.001 * (route["top_k"] - rank))
            if doc_id not in by_doc_id or adjusted > route_notes.get(doc_id, {}).get("adjusted_score", 0):
                by_doc_id[doc_id] = hit
                route_notes[doc_id] = {
                    "route": route["name"],
                    "adjusted_score": adjusted,
                    "source": source,
                    "doc_type": doc_type,
                    "matched_authority": source in ["source_of_truth", "release_notes", "governance"],
                    "matched_cache_namespace": "cache" in text_blob and "namespace" in text_blob
                }
            if source in ["source_of_truth", "release_notes"] and ("cache" in text_blob or "namespace" in text_blob):
                protected_ids[doc_id] = True

    protected = []
    normal = []
    for doc_id in by_doc_id:
        if doc_id in protected_ids:
            protected.append(by_doc_id[doc_id])
        else:
            normal.append(by_doc_id[doc_id])

    protected.sort(key=lambda h: route_notes.get(h.as_dict().get("doc_id", ""), {}).get("adjusted_score", 0), reverse=True)
    normal.sort(key=lambda h: route_notes.get(h.as_dict().get("doc_id", ""), {}).get("adjusted_score", 0), reverse=True)

    pre_rerank = []
    for hit in protected:
        if len(pre_rerank) < CANDIDATE_K:
            pre_rerank.append(hit)
    for hit in normal:
        if len(pre_rerank) < CANDIDATE_K:
            pre_rerank.append(hit)

    candidates = pre_rerank
    ctx.candidate_pool = len(candidates)

    ranked_hits = ctx.ranking.rerank(query, candidates, top_k=TOP_K)

    ctx.log("reflection", {
        "candidate_pool": len(candidates),
        "protected_evidence_count": len(protected),
        "routes_run": len(routes),
        "rerank_bound": CANDIDATE_K,
        "notes": "BM25 preserves exact cache namespace and release evidence terms; hybrid/dense cover the customer-to-release multi-hop; source_of_truth and release_notes evidence is protected before rerank."
    })

    return {"hits": ranked_hits, "candidates": candidates}

    def score_of(hit):

    def add_hits(hits, route_name, preserve=False, boost=0):

    rewrite_result = ctx.query_rewrite.rewrite(query, analysis=analysis, linked_entities=linked_entities)
    rewrites = rewrite_result.get("rewrites", [])

    tokens = query.replace(",", " ").replace("?", " ").replace(":", " ").split()
    exact_terms = []
    for token in tokens:

        "should_terms": ["CVE", "AtlasSearch", "4.9.0", "required action", "customers"],

        "boost": 20
    })

        "name": "blocked_customer_evidence",

        "mode": "hybrid",
        "top_k": 40,
        "include_doc_types": ["account_brief", "escalation", "approval_ledger", "sales_discovery", "meeting_note", "product_footprint"],
        "include_sources": ["crm", "support", "governance", "source_of_truth", "jira"],

        "include_doc_types": ["approval_ledger", "policy", "authority_matrix", "runbook", "security_advisory"],
        "include_sources": ["governance", "eval_policy", "source_of_truth", "runbook", "security"],
        "must_terms": [],
        "should_terms": ["SEC-1899", "CVE-2026-4520", "4.9.0", "approval"],
        "preserve": False,

    })
    for rewritten in rewrites[:3]:
        routes.append({
            "name": "rewrite_followup",

            "mode": "hybrid",
            "top_k": 25,
            "include_doc_types": allowed_doc_types,
            "include_sources": allowed_sources,

            "should_terms": ["SEC-1899", "CVE-2026-4520", "AtlasSearch", "4.9.0", "blocked", "customer"],

    for version in inferred_versions[:3]:
        hits = ctx.search.search(

            mode="bm25",

    def evidence_boost(item):
        m = meta(item)
        content = text_of(item)
        did = doc_id(item)

        source = m.get("source")

        return boost

    candidates = list(by_id.values())
    candidates.sort(key=evidence_boost, reverse=True)
    candidates = candidates[:CANDIDATE_K]

    preserved = []
    remainder = []
    for item in candidates:

        content = text_of(item)
        keep = False
        if m.get("ticket") == "SEC-1899" or "sec-1899" in content:

        if m.get("version") == "4.9.0" or "4.9.0" in content:

    rerank_input = preserved + remainder

    final_by_id = {}
    ranked_hits = []

    def append_final(item):
        did = doc_id(item)
        if did in final_by_id:

        data = as_dict(item)
        data["routes"] = route_notes.get(did, [])
        data["agentic_score"] = evidence_boost(item)
        ranked_hits.append(data)
        final_by_id[did] = True

    priority = []
    for item in candidates:
        m = meta(item)
        dt = m.get("doc_type")
        content = text_of(item)
        if dt == "security_ticket" and (m.get("ticket") == "SEC-1899" or "sec-1899" in content):
            priority.append(item)
    for item in candidates:
        m = meta(item)
        dt = m.get("doc_type")
        content = text_of(item)
        if dt in ["security_advisory", "release"] and (m.get("version") == "4.9.0" or "4.9.0" in content or m.get("cve") == "CVE-2026-4520" or "cve-2026-4520" in content):
            priority.append(item)
    for item in candidates:
        m = meta(item)
        dt = m.get("doc_type")
        content = text_of(item)
        if dt in ["approval_ledger", "account_brief", "escalation"] and (m.get("ticket") == "SEC-1899" or "sec-1899" in content or m.get("cve") == "CVE-2026-4520" or "cve-2026-4520" in content or m.get("version") == "4.9.0" or "4.9.0" in content):
            priority.append(item)

    for item in priority:
        append_final(item)
        if len(ranked_hits) >= TOP_K:
            break
    if len(ranked_hits) < TOP_K:
        for item in reranked:
            append_final(item)
            if len(ranked_hits) >= TOP_K:
                break

    ctx.log("reflection", {
        "candidate_pool": len(candidates),
        "inferred_cves": inferred_cves,
        "inferred_versions": inferred_versions,
        "inferred_customers": inferred_customers,
        "preserved_count": len(preserved),
        "top_doc_ids": [doc_id(hit) for hit in ranked_hits],
        "assessment": "initial evidence had the core SEC-1899 ticket, CVE, candidate customers, and 4.9.0 signal but included unrelated release/customer blockers, so this program adds CVE/version/customer fanout and downweights negative evidence for other CVEs or products"
    })

    return {"hits": ranked_hits[:TOP_K], "candidates": candidates}
